outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of protein domains, not a data plot.
Panel B consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot.
Panel C is a scatter/mean±SEM plot of fluorescence intensity that shows individual data points as blue circles for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel D shows mean±SEM fluorescence intensity with individual cell measurements overlaid as yellow circles.
Panel E displays mean±SEM GFP+ percentages with individual biological replicate values shown as green dots.
Panel F's inhibition zone plot shows mean±SEM with individual biological replicate values indicated by gray dots; the accompanying plate photographs are images, not plots.
Panel G consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot.
Panel H shows mean±SEM fluorescence intensity with individual cell data points overlaid as blue circles.
Panel I shows mean±SEM fluorescence intensity with individual cell data points overlaid as yellow circles.
Panel J is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
